title: Local MQTT messages, Hub <-> devices (ARCHITECTURE 5)
description: Topics: home/{device_key}/cmd (gateway only), home/{device_key}/ack, home/{device_key}/state (retained), home/{device_key}/telemetry, home/{device_key}/availability (retained, LWT, plain text 'online'/'offline'), home/{device_key}/event (one-off events, ADR 0012). Devices send raw values; the gateway adds source/quality/ts trust metadata.

event.description: One-off event (ADR 0012). 'type' is '<capability>.<name>' and must be listed in capabilities.json under that capability's 'events'; severity comes from there. NOT retained.

state.description: Used for both state and telemetry. home/{key}/state is RETAINED, so it must always carry the FULL current state of every capability of the device (a partial message would erase the rest). Telemetry may be partial. 'source' is 'assumed' for devices without feedback (IR); one message has one source.
